summary: Regression re-test of iteration_1 fixes. Backend: updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for the new OrderCreate schema (subtotal+shipping+total), added tests for server-side total recomputation, free-shipping >50k, and a new TestRoomFilter class for lowercase room slugs. 38/43 pass; the only 5 failures are the room filter (all 5 room slugs return 0 products). Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080): verified checkout total parity (cart 19,700 / checkout 19,700 / stored order subtotal 18,500 + shipping 1,200 + total 19,700 / track 19,700 for Halo Disc Wall Sconce), 404 catch-all on /this-does-not-exist and /privacy (renders NotFound + nav + footer + WhatsApp widget) — but ONLY after I fixed a missing `import NotFound` in App.js, NewsletterPopup suppressed on /admin /checkout /cart /auth and auto-closed when navigating into a hidden route while open (still fires on /about), Nav at 1920px (logo centered exactly at x=960, 156.7px gap after 'Rooms'), Track placeholder 'e.g. ADRB643CA52', /legal/privacy contains salesadorelighting@gmail.com and no hello@adore.com, Category pluralisation ('1 piece' on architectural, '2 pieces' on chandeliers), contact inline phone error (data-testid='contact-phone-error' visible with message, valid 10-digit submits successfully), home sections + 0 broken images after full scroll, PDP (gallery thumbs, temp-warm/temp-cool toggle, 3 reviews, trust content), admin login + product create/edit/delete + orders/inquiries tabs.

critical.issue: Room filter is a case-sensitive exact match ({'room': room}) while seeded products store capitalised rooms ('Living','Bedroom','Dining','Outdoor','Staircase'). Rooms.jsx now links to lowercase slugs (/rooms/living), so ALL 5 room landing pages render '0 pieces / No pieces in this collection yet.' Fix: case-insensitive query e.g. {'room': {'$regex': f'^{re.escape(room)}$', '$options': 'i'}} (or normalise seed data). Verified: ?room=living -> [], ?room=Living -> 3 products.

minor.issue: OrderCreate still requires client subtotal/shipping/total although the server recomputes and ignores them — they are dead required fields; consider making them optional or dropping them.
Still no slug uniqueness check (409); duplicate slugs make a product unreachable via GET /api/products/{slug}. Carried over from iteration_1.
Still no pagination; hard cap to_list(500). Carried over from iteration_1.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER (fixed by me): Route path='*' element={<NotFound />} was added but NotFound was never imported, so any unknown URL threw 'NotFound is not defined' and rendered a blank page (the exact bug this iteration was meant to fix). I added `import NotFound from "@/pages/NotFound";`. Main agent should keep this import.
Room landing page heading renders the raw slug ('living') instead of the room label ('Living Room'), and the copy reads 'Considered lighting for the living'. Map the slug to ROOMS[].name for display.

integration_issues.issue: /rooms/<slug> pages show zero products for every room due to the backend case-sensitive room filter (see backend critical).

issues: Carried over from iteration_1 (not re-verified as fixed): light eyebrow text 'SPRING EDITION - 2026' and 'BESPOKE COMMISSIONS' CTA over a bright photo with no scrim.

action_items: HIGH: Make the backend room filter case-insensitive (or seed lowercase room values) so /rooms/living, /rooms/bedroom, /rooms/dining, /rooms/outdoor, /rooms/staircase return products.
MEDIUM: Show the human room name on /rooms/:slug instead of the raw lowercase slug.
NOTE: I added the missing `import NotFound` to App.js — do not remove it.
LOW/backend: make subtotal/shipping/total optional in OrderCreate (server-authoritative), add slug uniqueness (409) and pagination to GET /api/products.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js referenced <NotFound /> without an import — CRA/webpack still 'compiled successfully' so this only failed at runtime; always smoke-test a new route after adding it.
server.py list_products: `q['room'] = room` exact match couples the API contract to seed-data casing. Normalise on write and on read.
server.py create_order accepts subtotal/shipping/total from the client but ignores them; keeping them required invites future mismatch bugs.
server.py is ~640 lines with 100+ lines of SAMPLE_PRODUCTS inline — move seed data to backend/seed_data.py (repeat comment from iteration_1).

success_rate.backend: 88% (38/43 pytest cases; 5 failures all from the room filter)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% of flows pass; 1 blocker fixed in-test-scope, 1 HIGH backend-driven room page failure, 1 MEDIUM copy issue

seed_data_creation: 1 COD order ADRD79245B0 (Halo Disc Wall Sconce, total Rs 19,700), several TEST_ orders/inquiries/newsletter signups from pytest, 1 contact inquiry (TEST_c@example.com). Admin CRUD product 'test-regression-lamp' was created, edited and deleted; product count back at 12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (43 cases; TestRoomFilter is the only failing class and is an intentional red test for the case-sensitive room filter — it should go green once backend does a case-insensitive room lookup). Admin form testids are admin-name / admin-slug / admin-price / admin-save-product (NOT admin-form-*). PDP temperature toggles are temp-warm / temp-cool. Suppress the popup with add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('adore_popup_seen','1');"). Verified fixed this iteration: checkout total parity, 404 route (after adding the missing import), popup route exclusion, nav 3-col grid, track placeholder, legal email, category pluralisation, contact inline phone error. Still open: room filter case mismatch and /rooms/:slug heading showing the raw slug.
rca_of_the_issue: Room pages: Rooms.jsx now links lowercase slugs and Category.jsx passes ?room=living to GET /api/products, but server.py builds `q['room'] = room` as an exact, case-sensitive Mongo match while seeded documents store 'Living'/'Bedroom'/etc., so every room query returns []. 404 route: App.js added <Route path='*' element={<NotFound />}/> but omitted the import, producing a runtime ReferenceError and the same blank page as iteration_1 until the import was added.
